Hi Walter,

You are right, and I am not going to argue with any of it. You bought a 12 TH/s unit on September 9, we did not tell you it was delayed, and then the 40T date we moved you onto passed without a word either. That is on us, not on you.

Where it stands now. I have put a hold on both orders and on both warehouse shipments, so nothing can go out while the refund is being settled. Shop···· is $839.00 and Shop···· is $1,147.49, both in full, with no fee of any kind since nothing shipped. I have also corrected the note on your file so the $839.00 goes back to the Amex you used, not PayPal.

The refund itself is pressed by Abel or Georges, not by me, and it is in front of them now with both amounts and the Amex correction. A colleague is picking it up today. Once it is issued, card and Afterpay refunds take 3 to 5 business days to land, and I will write to you here the moment it is processed so you are not left guessing again.

Sorry it ended this way, Walter.

Sarah
